"Kayla is an Omega who’s tired of sleeping around every time her heat starts. When her friend Minnie tells her about a company that runs a private hotel for Alphas and Omegas, she decides to give it a try. Female Alphas are rare, but Kayla’s luck turns when she’s paired with Cecilia. What was meant to be a practical arrangement quickly becomes something far more intense than she expected."
